title: AI结构性变革速览：GPT-6.2、Gemini 4 Neon与新基准驱动技术、资本与风险同步升级
core_insight: 自研自改模型、量子辅助训练与高效推理框架的突破，加上Anthropic千亿美元IPO等资本热潮，标志着AI正向更强大、成本更低且商业化深度更高的结构性跃迁。

dimension_texts.technology: GPT‑6.2 Astra/Sol提升专业编码与推理，Gemini 4 Neon扩展多模态长上下文，Violetto 1B模型实现高吞吐数学推理，MInfoVisQA提升多语言视觉问答能力，整体展示了从通用大模型到细分任务模型的能力层级化提升。 出现自我权重重写、Speculative‑diffusion并行草稿、Hybrid Quantum Selection量子辅助学习率调度、DeltaHarness自适应工具执行以及FieldGuide的Token‑efficient文档探索等多种训练与推理新范式，预示模型从静态一次性训练向动态、可自演化方向转变。 Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding Introducing Gemini 4 Neon Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment Hybrid Quantum Selection of Learning Rates in Language-Model Training: Termination Criteria and an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report MInfoVisQA: A Multilingual Benchmark for Information-Rich Visual Question Answering FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agentic Document Exploration
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Speculative‑diffusion、AdaFlowLite异步非阻塞推理以及Violetto的高吞吐模型结构显著降低每 token 或每任务的计算成本，Token‑efficient的FieldGuide进一步削减检索/探索算力需求。 OpenAI展示AI辅助芯片设计，虽无新硬件发布，但开源高效模型（Maxwell‑V1‑Flash、AdaFlowLite）与软件层面优化表明算力利用率持续提升。 DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
